nemar-quality:percentBrainComponents.description: Share of components whose most probable ICLabel class is Brain.

nemar-quality:mutualInformationReduction.description: Mutual information reduction of the decomposition: the mutual information its unmixing removes from the sphered data, log|det W| + sum h(x_i) - sum h(y_i), each entropy over 256 fixed bins (eegprep's eeg_mir). Not comparable with Delorme et al. 2012 or the legacy NEMAR report, whose MIR includes the reduction sphering achieves.

icclasses.caption: Independent components counted by their most probable ICLabel class. Beside each class X is the summed variance of components classed X: the sum of each component's own share of the data's variance, not the variance the class explains, since the components are not orthogonal.
